blocks.text: Event handling aur interactivity program ko user ke kaam ka jawab dene deti hain. Event aik kaam hai, jaise button dabana ya text likhna. Program har waqt chalte rehne ke bajaye event ka intezar karta hai. Event hone par aik khaas kaam hota hai. Is se application chust aur mufeed banti hai. Graphical programs mein event handling zaroori hai; yeh program ka rawayya control karti hai.

items: Event: user ka kaam, jaise click ya typing.
Program event ka intezar karta hai aur event par khaas kaam karta hai.
